verdict.rationale: Codegen publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages covering agent runs, logs, integrations, setup commands, sandbox and pull-request endpoints, and the SDK docs include code examples. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive 'try it' playground or runnable-in-browser examples, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 at all candidate paths. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive/runnable request playground, published OpenAPI spec, runnable examples on API reference pages, independent corroboration.
